code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    obj = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 8]
    marks = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (0, 8)]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in obj), max(r for r, c in obj)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in obj), max(c for r, c in obj)
    mr0, mr1 = min(r for r, c in marks), max(r for r, c in marks)
    mc0, mc1 = min(c for r, c in marks), max(c for r, c in marks)
    pattern = [list(grid[r][mc0:mc1 + 1]) for r in range(mr0, mr1 + 1)]
    rotated = [list(row) for row in zip(*pattern[::-1])]
    scale = (r1 - r0 + 1) // len(rotated)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for i, row in enumerate(rotated):
        for j, color in enumerate(row):
            if color:
                for r in range(r0 + i * scale, r0 + (i + 1) * scale):
                    for c in range(c0 + j * scale, c0 + (j + 1) * scale):
                        if out[r][c] == 8:
                            out[r][c] = color
    return out
'''
p.write_text(code)
